vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Ruth taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. 3 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: European Elder — named and noted.
Ruth has been turning the European Elder over — asking after it at fires, handling it on work days — and now knows it deep enough to teach. (Their trade grows: ask them what they know.)
Fireside lesson: Ruth passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
💡 European Elder: the village and a trader know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
Diaa: "European Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🛡️ Charlotte, Lars, Jesse, Ruth and Sofia met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Charlotte, Lars, Jesse, Ruth, Sofia are hurt.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village and a trader know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maeve just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Charlotte, Maeve, Oliver, Theo and Ruth met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Maeve, Oliver, Theo, Ruth are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruth just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Theo taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Theo drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village and a trader know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
Sofia: "European Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder The Ugly Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Ugly Beast!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Devon just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nii met them at the door — 1 put down. Nii is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
